lines.en: label otohaspecial10:
The two of us make our way across town and, while I {i}think{/i} about asking Otoha if she needs any help carrying her things, I decide against it because the walk is kind of long.
lines.zh: 我们俩穿过城区往前走，我{i}想{/i}过要不要问 Otoha 需不需要帮忙拿东西，可最后决定算了，因为这段路有点长。

lines.en: Not extremely long, but long enough to make me not want to carry her things. Which I guess would be any amount of distance whatsoever.
lines.zh: 不是特别长，但已经长到让我不想替她拿东西了。不过我想，不管多远我大概都不想拿。

lines.en: But that’s beside the point.
lines.zh: 不过这不是重点。

lines.en: Either way, she doesn’t seem to mind as she gets caught up in a text conversation with who I imagine is either Rin or a mysterious secret girlfriend she is keeping on the side.
lines.zh: 总之她看起来并不介意，因为她已经陷进了一段短信对话里——对方我想要么是 Rin，要么是她在外面偷偷养着的某个神秘女友。

lines.en: Maybe that’s why Otoha doesn’t want Rin to meet her parents? Maybe they’ve already met her {i}real{/i} girlfriend?
lines.zh: 也许这就是 Otoha 不想让 Rin 见她父母的原因？也许他们已经见过她{i}真正的{/i}女朋友了？

lines.en: I can admire that.
lines.zh: 这份本事我倒是佩服。

lines.en: I’ll have to ask her about how she manages to effectively keep her primary relationship hidden once we finish descending this suspicious staircase.
lines.zh: 等我们走完这段可疑的楼梯，我得问问她是怎么把主要的那段关系藏得这么好的。

lines.en: scene otohabasement1
: Something wrong, bud?
lines.zh: : 有什么问题吗，老兄？

lines.en: : Do you really sing in here? Because I feel like this sort of environment would just kill the mood.
lines.zh: : 你真的在这种地方唱歌？我觉得这种环境只会把气氛全毁了。

lines.en: : The acoustics are nice at least.
lines.zh: : 至少声学效果还不错。

lines.en: I guess Otoha and Rin really weren’t kidding when they were talking about the sketchy basement Otoha gets her vocal lessons in.
lines.zh: 看来 Otoha 和 Rin 说的那个她上声乐课的可疑地下室，还真不是在开玩笑。

lines.en: To think someone like Niki would willingly spend time in a place like this is a little bizarre to me, though.
lines.zh: 不过想想像 Niki 这样的人居然会心甘情愿待在这种地方，我觉得有点怪。

lines.en: I get that her whole idol persona isn’t really the true “her,” but I can’t imagine the true her would like something dark and damp either.
lines.zh: 我明白她那套偶像人设并不是真正的“她”，但我也想象不出真正的她会喜欢又黑又潮的地方。

lines.en: But hey, if Otoha is fine spending time in a room where someone has probably been murdered, more power to her.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，如果 Otoha 不介意待在一个大概死过人的房间里，那就随她去吧。

lines.en: : Oh, good. You’re-
lines.zh: : 哦，很好。你——

lines.en: scene otohabasement2
: Wait, why are {i}you{/i} here?
lines.zh: : 等等，{i}你{/i}为什么会在这儿？

lines.en: : I want to learn how to sing.
lines.zh: : 我想学唱歌。

lines.en: : Oh, okay. So Otoha tried to come alone and you followed her?
lines.zh: : 哦，好吧。所以是 Otoha 想一个人来，结果你跟来了？

lines.en: : Stop knowing me so well. It makes my sarcasm less funny.
lines.zh: : 别这么了解我。这让我讽刺起来都没那么好笑了。

lines.en: scene otohabasement3
: You guessed it. Sorry that he knows where you work now. I understand if you want to relocate and I’m willing to help you find some other sketchy basement if you want.
lines.zh: : 猜对了。抱歉，他现在知道你工作的地方了。你想搬走的话我理解，如果需要，我愿意帮你再找一个同样可疑的地下室。

lines.en: : It’s fine. If it was anyone else, I’d be a little disappointed. But I’ve gotten pretty good at dealing with this thing over the years.
lines.zh: : 没关系。换成别人我可能还会有点失望。不过这些年来，我对付这个东西已经相当拿手了。

lines.en: : So I’m just a {i}thing{/i} now?
lines.zh: : 所以我现在只是个{i}东西{/i}了？

lines.en: scene otohabasement4
: Yes, but only just barely.
lines.zh: : 是的，不过也就勉强算是。

lines.en: : You can stay here and watch, but if you do anything to disturb my lesson, I’m...going to be really mad.
lines.zh: : 你可以留在这儿看，但你要是敢打扰我上课，我……会非常生气。

lines.en: : I am shaking in my boots.
lines.zh: : 我吓得靴子都在抖。

lines.en: scene otohabasement5
: Oh, I brought back all those CDs and DVDs you lent me, and you were totally right. It’s really easy to see how you’ve improved over the years if you check everything out side by side.
lines.zh: : 哦，你借给我的那些 CD 和 DVD 我都带回来了，你说得完全没错。把所有东西摆在一起对比，真的很容易看出你这些年进步了多少。

lines.en: : I’m still getting better, too. And before long, I’m sure someone else will be saying the same sort of things about your performances.
lines.zh: : 我也还在进步。而且用不了多久，我相信也会有人对着你的演出说同样的话。

lines.en: : This is boring.
lines.zh: : 好无聊。

lines.en: scene otohabasement6
: Okay, {i}now{/i} you can leave.
lines.zh: : 好了，{i}现在{/i}你可以走了。

lines.en: : What exactly did you expect when you agreed to come to a singing lesson?
lines.zh: : 你答应来上声乐课的时候，到底在期待什么？

lines.en: : Well, singing for one.
lines.zh: : 首先，唱歌啊。

lines.en: : We’ve been here for a grand total of two and a half minutes. I don’t even know what today’s lesson is on yet.
lines.zh: : 我们总共才来了两分半钟。我连今天的课要上什么都还不知道。

lines.en: scene otohabasement7
: Oh, we’ll be working on your stamina today. The longer you’re able to last, the better and more consistent your performance will be.
lines.zh: : 哦，我们今天练的是持久力。你能撑得越久，演出就越好、也越稳定。

lines.en: Wow, maybe I {i}do{/i} want to learn how to sing after all.
lines.zh: 哇，也许我{i}还真{/i}想学学唱歌了。

lines.en: : You’re not going to make me, like...dance are you? Because I can not fucking dance to save my life. And I’m not really trying to be an idol either.
lines.zh: : 你不会要让我……跳舞什么的吧？因为我他妈的跳舞能要了我的命。而且我又不是真想当偶像。

lines.en: : I’m not going to make you dance. I’m talking more about vocal stamina anyway.
lines.zh: : 我不会让你跳舞。我说的本来就只是声音上的持久力。

lines.en: : And, while dancing does help to build up cardio and exercise your lungs, there are ways to improve it without going down that path.
lines.zh: : 虽说跳舞确实能锻炼心肺，但不用走那条路也有办法提升。

lines.en: : Welp, I’m ready whenever you are.
lines.zh: : 好吧，你什么时候开始都行。

lines.en: scene otohabasement8
: Are you able to behave yourself while I show you how a real teacher does her job? Or are you going to continue annoying us until we pay attention to you?
lines.zh: : 我要让你看看真正的老师是怎么干活的，你能老实点吗？还是你要继续烦我们，直到我们理你为止？

lines.en: : I’ll just hang out on the couch until the lesson is over.
lines.zh: : 我就在沙发上待着，等课结束。

lines.en: : If you’re going to watch porn on your phone, please keep the volume muted.
lines.zh: : 你要是在手机上看片，请把音量关掉。

lines.en: : Or just...don’t watch porn on your phone.
lines.zh: : 或者干脆……别在手机上看片。

lines.en: : You two are really asking a lot of me today.
lines.zh: : 你们俩今天对我的要求还真多。

lines.en: : I think not watching porn on my instructor’s couch is a pretty fair thing to ask in exchange for following me across town.
lines.zh: : 我觉得，作为我让你大老远跟着我穿过城区的交换条件，别在我老师的沙发上看片，这个要求挺合理的。

lines.en: : Fine. But I’m only agreeing to prevent Niki from “getting really mad.” I have no idea how I would survive something as rare and unheard of as {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 行。不过我答应，只是为了不让 Niki “非常生气”。像{i}那种事{/i}这么罕见、前所未闻，我真不知道自己怎么扛得住。

lines.en: : Have I told you that I hate you yet today? Because I hate you.
lines.zh: : 我今天还没跟你说过我恨你吧？因为我恨你。

lines.en: scene black
Otoha and Niki move to the other side of the room, but that isn’t really saying much since this basement is only slightly larger than my bedroom.
lines.zh: Otoha 和 Niki 挪到了房间的另一头，不过这也没多远，因为这间地下室只比我的卧室大一点点。

lines.en: I take a seat on the couch and observe my surroundings but, after running out of things to look at after only twenty seconds, I begin to focus on Otoha and Niki instead.
lines.zh: 我在沙发上坐下，打量四周，可才过了二十秒就没东西可看了，于是我转而盯着 Otoha 和 Niki 看。

lines.en: It’s refreshing to see the two of them out here this early in the morning just...doing what they love.
lines.zh: 一大早就能看到她们俩在这儿……做着自己喜欢的事，感觉挺新鲜的。

lines.en: Even if what they love is no fun to observe if it’s not on some sort of stage.
lines.zh: 哪怕她们喜欢的事，不在某种舞台上就一点都不好看。

lines.en: scene otohabasement9
Otoha takes her position near the stairs, straightening her body out and awaiting Niki’s instructions.
lines.zh: Otoha 在楼梯附近站定，把身体挺直，等着 Niki 的指示。

lines.en: It’s the first time I’ve actually seen her interested in learning something but, to be fair, it’s not like I’ve created many opportunities for her to feel that way.
lines.zh: 这还是我第一次真正看到她对学东西感兴趣，不过说句公道话，我也从来没给她创造过多少机会让她有这种感觉。

lines.en: Maybe I should, though.
lines.zh: 不过也许我该这么做。

lines.en: I mean, if Niki’s going to go out of her way to-
lines.zh: 我是说，既然 Niki 都肯这么费心去——

lines.en: You know what? Nope. I can’t do it.
lines.zh: 你知道吗？算了。我做不到。

lines.en: I seriously contemplated the idea of teaching for a fraction of a second right there and I can already feel myself falling asleep.
lines.zh: 我刚才真的认真考虑了一瞬间「去教书」这个念头，而我已经能感觉到自己在犯困了。

lines.en: scene otohabasement10
Oh, good. Someone probably felt that I was in trouble and is calling to keep me occupied and prevent me from falling asleep.
lines.zh: 哦，好。大概是有人感应到我有难，打电话来让我有点事做，免得我睡着。

lines.en: : Please tell me you’re not going to-
lines.zh: : 拜托告诉我你不会要——

lines.en: scene otohabasement11
: Hello?
: ...answer that.
lines.zh: : ……接起来。

lines.en: : Otoha! Eyes forward. Don’t pay any attention to him.
lines.zh: : Otoha！眼睛看前面。别理他。

lines.en: scene otohabasement12
: Got it.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: : If you’re ever going to make it as a musician, you’re going to have to learn how to avoid distractions.
lines.zh: : 你要是真想当上音乐人，就得学会不受干扰。

lines.en: : Let’s make the most of this opportunity by pretending he’s some asshole in the crowd.
lines.zh: : 我们好好利用这个机会，就把他当成观众里的某个混蛋吧。

lines.en: : Now, deep breaths. Take in as much air as you can and start warming up with the two octave pitch glide tactic I taught you. Whenever you’re ready.
lines.zh: : 现在，深呼吸。尽可能吸足气，然后用我教你的两八度音高滑音法开始练声。你准备好了就开始。

lines.en: : Without the piano this time. You should be able to remember the notes by now. And I {i}will{/i} call you out if you’re off key.
lines.zh: : 这次不用钢琴。你现在应该能记住那些音了。要是你走调，我{i}一定{/i}会点名说你。

lines.en: : Understood.
lines.zh: : 明白。

lines.en: scene otohabasement13
: Hello? Is anyone there?
lines.zh: : 喂？有人在吗？

lines.en: : {i}Oh! Yeah. Hey. Sorry, I thought I heard Otoha and- wait, yeah. That’s definitely Otoha.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦！对。嘿。抱歉，我好像听见 Otoha 的声音，等等，没错。那绝对是 Otoha。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Is she...is she fucking moaning right now?? What is that noise?? What the fuck are-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她在……她他妈的在呻吟吗？？那是什么声音？？到底他妈的——{/i}

lines.en: : I’m at her singing lesson...
lines.zh: : 我在她的声乐课上……

lines.en: : {i}Oh, right! She had one of those today.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哦，对！她今天有一节。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I was wondering why you didn’t show up to the cafe this morning. But now that I know you’re at her-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我还在想你今早怎么没来咖啡厅。不过既然我知道你在她的——{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Wait. Nope. Still not making any sense to me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}等等。不对。我还是想不通。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Are her parents there too? Am I the only one not invited?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}她爸妈也在吗？就我没被邀请？{/i}

lines.en: : Yeah. Her entire extended family is here and we’re all saying bad things about you.
lines.zh: : 对。她一大家子亲戚全都在，我们正一起说你坏话呢。

lines.en: : {i}Ha ha ha. Do you guys have any plans after that? Because I have to work a little later today and I wanted you to come keep me company.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}哈哈哈。你们之后有什么安排吗？因为我今天要晚点才下班，本来想让你来陪我。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}But if both of you are together, that’s even bet- WAIT. IDEA.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不过要是你们俩在一起，那就更——等等。有主意了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Otoha’s instructor is your ex, right? How “ex” is she exactly? Like...if I were to propose that all four of us went out on a double date tonight, would that be weird?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}Otoha 的老师是你前任，对吧？到底有多“前”？比如……要是我提议今晚我们四个一起出去来个双重约会，会不会很怪？{/i}

lines.en: : For me? No. But I figured you’d be a little hesitant given the current state of things.
lines.zh: : 对我来说？不会。不过我以为考虑到现在的状况，你会有点犹豫。

lines.en: : {i}Me? Nah. I’m over it.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我？不会。我已经放下了。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Well, not really. But this sounds fun and I kind of, like...need to get out and do something.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗯，也不全是。不过听上去挺好玩，而且我有点……需要出去做点什么。{/i}

lines.en: : I’ll ask them, but-
lines.zh: : 我会问她们的，不过——

lines.en: : {i}Shit! Like six million people just walked in. Gotta go, Sensei! Ask Otoha to check her phone whenever she’s done!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}靠！一下子进来大概六百万人。我得挂了，Sensei！等 Otoha 结束了让她看下手机！{/i}

lines.en: : Sounds good. Talk to you later, Rin.
lines.zh: : 好的。回头聊，Rin。

lines.en: : AAAAaaaaaaAAAAAaaaa-
lines.zh: : AAAAaaaaaaAAAAAaaaa-

lines.en: scene otohabasement14
: Wait, Rin? Why was Rin calling you?
lines.zh: : 等等，Rin？Rin 为什么打给你？

lines.en: : Ah-ah-ah! Eyes forward!
lines.zh: : 啊——啊——啊！眼睛看前面！

lines.en: scene otohabasement15
: Oh, yeah. Sorry...It’s just that the two of us are kind of fighting right now and-
lines.zh: : 哦，对。抱歉……只是我们俩现在有点在吵架，然后——

lines.en: : Singing now, drama later. You need to get your head in the game.
lines.zh: : 现在唱歌，戏码留到以后。你得把心思放进来。

lines.en: : You think the audience would give two shits about what’s happening between you and your girlfriend? No. Because the audience wouldn’t even {i}know{/i} about your girlfriend.
lines.zh: : 你以为观众会在乎你和你女朋友之间发生了什么吗？不会。因为观众{i}根本就不知道{/i}你有没有女朋友。

lines.en: : In fact, the audience {i}is{/i} your girlfriend. As long as you’re up on stage, they are the only thing that matters.
lines.zh: : 事实上，观众{i}就是{/i}你的女朋友。只要你站在台上，他们就是唯一重要的东西。

lines.en: : Now, keep going.
lines.zh: : 好了，继续。

lines.en: scene otohabasement16
: Right now? But you’re still holding-
lines.zh: : 现在？可你还按着——

lines.en: : Keep. Going.
lines.zh: : 继续。唱。

lines.en: scene otohabasement17
: A...AAAAAAaaaaaAAAAAaaaaAAAAAHHH...
lines.zh: : A...AAAAAAaaaaaAAAAAaaaaAAAAAHHH...

lines.en: scene black

Feeling that I’ve already annoyed Niki and Otoha (But mostly Otoha) enough during this lesson, I decide to remain quiet this time around and focus on the two of them as they get lost in their element.
lines.zh: 觉得这节课上我已经把 Niki 和 Otoha（但主要是 Otoha）烦得够呛，这次我决定安静下来，专心看着她们俩沉浸在自己的状态里。

lines.en: Despite not properly following orders or whatever is going on, Otoha’s voice is both powerful and beautiful- which says a lot since she’s just cycling through one sound at different pitches right now.
lines.zh: 尽管她没怎么好好照做、或者管它到底是怎么回事，Otoha 的嗓音既有力又好听——这可很能说明问题，毕竟她现在只是把同一个音在不同音高上循环而已。

lines.en: And Niki...Well, she is just as much of a demon as always. But she clearly knows what she’s doing and is a lot more serious about teaching than I expected her to be.
lines.zh: 至于 Niki……嗯，她还是一如既往地像个恶魔。但她显然很清楚自己在做什么，而且对教学认真得出乎我的意料。

lines.en: : AAAAAAaaaaaah-
lines.zh: : AAAAAAaaaaaah-

lines.en: : Stop. No. What is that? What are you doing?
lines.zh: : 停。不对。那是什么？你在干什么？

lines.en: : Huh? What? I...don’t know. What did I do wrong? It sounded fine in my head.
lines.zh: : 啊？什么？我……不知道。我哪里做错了？在我听来挺正常的啊。

lines.en: : Yeah, that’s exactly the problem. Look-
lines.zh: : 是啊，问题就在这儿。你看——

lines.en: scene otohabasement18
: Woah! Niki?
lines.zh: : 哇哦！Niki？

lines.en: : Stop focusing so much on your head. Your voice is fine when you sing with that section of your body. What you’re struggling with is down here.
lines.zh: : 别把注意力全放在头上。你用身体那个部位唱的时候，声音是没问题的。你卡住的地方在下面这儿。

lines.en: : If you’re going to drop octaves, keeping everything up in your head is going to sound fucking horrible. You need to focus on your diaphragm more.
lines.zh: : 你要往下走八度，还把所有东西都顶在头上，那听起来会他妈的难听死了。你得把注意力多放在横膈膜上。

lines.en: : How does it feel when I press there?
lines.zh: : 我按这里的时候感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Uhhhhh...I don’t know?
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……我不知道？

lines.en: scene otohabasement19
: Liar. Try singing right now.
lines.zh: : 撒谎。你现在试着唱一下。

lines.en: : I...can’t.
lines.zh: : 我……唱不了。

lines.en: : Exactly. Because if I’m pressing down like this, it’s impairing your ability to not only breathe, but to bend and create sounds.
lines.zh: : 这就对了。因为我这么按下去，会削弱你呼吸的能力，还有转折和发声的能力。

lines.en: : I mean...yeah, but...that’s not really what I-
lines.zh: : 我是说……是，可是……我说的其实不是——

lines.en: : Learning to use this properly is going to be a major key in controlling your stamina and expanding your range.
lines.zh: : 学会正确运用这里，是你控制持久力、扩展音域的关键。

lines.en: : It sucks right now because all you’re doing is singing with your head. It’s no wonder you always sound so strained after a few songs.
lines.zh: : 现在听着很糟，因为你完全是在用头唱歌。难怪你唱了几首之后声音总是那么紧。

lines.en: scene otohabasement20
: And why the fuck is your face so red right now? Are you embarrassed? Why? There is {i}one{/i} person watching you.
lines.zh: : 还有你的脸他妈的为什么这么红？你害羞了？为什么？看你的就{i}一个{/i}人。

lines.en: : If you’re this red now, I can only imagine how you’ll be when you’ve got thousands of people watching.
lines.zh: : 你现在就这么红，我真不敢想象有几千人看着你的时候你会什么样。

lines.en: : Assuming you’re ever able to perform for more than ten minutes without your vocal cords giving out and-
lines.zh: : 前提是你哪天能撑过十分钟而声带不罢工，然后——

lines.en: scene black
: Sorry, just gotta...run to the bathroom really quick! Be back soon!
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我得……赶紧去趟洗手间！马上回来！

lines.en: Otoha breaks away from Niki and darts up the stairs, leaving the two of us alone in the basement together.
lines.zh: Otoha 挣脱 Niki，冲上楼梯，把我和她两个人单独留在了地下室里。

lines.en: scene otohabasement21
: So...having fun?
lines.zh: : 那么……玩得开心吗？

lines.en: : You do realize why she was actually blushing that hard, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道她脸红成那样其实是因为什么吧？

lines.en: : Because I’m hot and famous and I was touching her. Anyone with even half of a brain cell would blush like that.
lines.zh: : 因为我又火又有名，而且我在摸她。只要还有半个脑细胞的人，都会脸红成那样。

lines.en: : But I’m not just going to come out and say that to her when it would embarrass her so badly that she’d never come back.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会当面跟她说破，那会让她羞得再也不来了。

lines.en: : That just means more free time for you.
lines.zh: : 那你不就多了些自由时间。

lines.en: : I don’t care about free time for myself. Otoha’s got serious potential, and I’ll be damned if I don’t help her get every last drop of it out.
lines.zh: : 我才不在乎自己有没有自由时间。Otoha 的潜力大得很，我要是不帮她把最后一滴都榨出来，我就不是人。

lines.en: : You-
: If you make a fucking penis joke right now, I swear to God I’ll fucking kill you.
lines.zh: : 你要是现在敢开那种鸡巴玩笑，我对天发誓我他妈杀了你。

lines.en: : I was just going to say that I admire how strict and dedicated you are to your students. You’re a real role model, Niki.
lines.zh: : 我本来只是想说，我很佩服你对学生这么严格又这么上心。你真是个榜样，Niki。

lines.en: : I know I am. But thanks anyway.
lines.zh: : 我知道我是。不过还是谢了。

lines.en: : Okay! Back.
lines.zh: : 好了！回来了。

lines.en: scene otohabasement22
: Sorry about that. Just needed to get some fresh air.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。只是需要透透气。

lines.en: : In the bathroom?
lines.zh: : 在洗手间里透气？

lines.en: : There was a window?
lines.zh: : 那儿有扇窗？

lines.en: : Whatever. Just get back into position and we’ll start on some more stamina-
lines.zh: : 随便吧。回到位置上，我们继续练持久力——

lines.en: : Oh, before that.
lines.zh: : 哦，在那之前。

lines.en: scene otohabasement23
: What do you mean {i}before{/i} that? We’re on {i}my{/i} time right now. I don’t have all fucking day.
lines.zh: : {i}在那之前{/i}是什么意思？现在用的是{i}我的{/i}时间。我可没有一整天他妈的耗在这儿。

lines.en: : I know. I just wanted to see if you’d go on a date with me.
lines.zh: : 我知道。我只是想问问你愿不愿意跟我约会。

lines.en: scene otohabasement24
: Wait...an actual date? Like...just the two of us?
lines.zh: : 等等……真正的约会？就是……只有我们两个？

lines.en: : Yeah.
: And Otoha.
lines.zh: : 还有 Otoha。

lines.en: : I’m sorry. What?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。什么？

lines.en: scene otohabasement25
: Oh, you better have a good fucking explanation for this.
lines.zh: : 哦，你最好有个像样的解释，我他妈的警告你。

lines.en: : You know, I actually do this time.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，这次我还真有。

lines.en: : Well, then? Out with it.
lines.zh: : 那还等什么？说吧。

lines.en: scene black
I tell Otoha and Niki about Rin’s double date idea and both of them seem to be completely fine with it after a short discussion.
lines.zh: 我把 Rin 的双重约会提议告诉了 Otoha 和 Niki，简短讨论之后，两人似乎都完全没意见。

lines.en: Strangely enough, it’s actually Otoha who needs a little prodding in order to agree. But I’m sure that’s just because I’m going to be there.
lines.zh: 说来奇怪，反倒是需要劝一劝才答应的其实是 Otoha。不过我敢说那只是因为我也要去。

lines.en: Niki, on the other hand, is all for the idea.
lines.zh: 而 Niki 则举双手赞成。

lines.en: In fact, she likes it so much that she even offers to have one of the drivers from her agency come pick us up after a choreography session she has booked after Otoha’s lesson.
lines.zh: 事实上她喜欢到这个地步，甚至提出让事务所的司机来接我们——在她给 Otoha 上完课之后的编舞训练结束之后。

lines.en: Not wanting to impose, however, Otoha rejects the idea and uses the whole “Improving her stamina” thing as an excuse to walk there instead.
lines.zh: 不过 Otoha 不想太麻烦别人，就拒绝了这个提议，拿“提升持久力”当借口，说要走路过去。

lines.en: Eventually, the two of them are able to get back to Otoha’s lesson, while I-
lines.zh: 最后她们俩总算回到了 Otoha 的课上，而我——

lines.en: Well...
Let’s just say I wound up watching something on my phone that neither of them wanted me to watch for the next hour.
lines.zh: 这么说吧，接下来的一个小时里，我在手机上看了一样她们俩都不希望我看的东西。

lines.en: But...
lines.zh: 不过……

lines.en: At least it was muted.
lines.zh: 至少我把音量关了。
